cues.text: "Well, bravo!
You seem to have understood what this game is about!",
says the king and happily folds his hands over his stomach,
"But before you have even the slightest chance of being able to challenge Zargon,
you must first defeat his vassal: Mylgor!
You know him: he was the one who ordered you to assassinate Firon - my younger brother,
who emigrated when Zargon came to power and is now holed up with a
handful of the old members of his secret society in a palace of ice,
to be safe from further persecution by Zargon's henchmen.
I assume Mylgor has already been informed of the failure of his plan
and is therefore hiding in the secret chambers beneath his little hut:
I don't know how you can get there,
but maybe this spell will help you open doors locked by a spell.
It's not strong enough to break barriers like the
ones Zargon put around the world gate behind the waterfall,
but it is all that remains of my once mighty magical powers...
And now let me teach you the spell..."
The king places three fingers of his right hand on your forehead,
and a cold shiver comes over you as you suddenly feel the icy coldness of his body...
Richard murmurs a few throaty sounds in a strange,
ancient language and then opens his eyes again:
You now have the remaining astral energy that he still had...
